items.name: Section 2 Personnel Eligibility Verification
items.description: Verifies VERAS Section 2 personnel against APM Section 45.22 eligibility criteria and maps timesheet org codes to Departmental Grant Administrators (DGAs) using the institutional Department List. Operator uploads three workflow documents together — the VERAS proposal package, the Banner NBAJOBS extract for each person on the proposal, and the institutional Department List — and the workflow returns a verification matrix with per-person eligibility determinations, per-org-code DGA mappings, and flags for ineligible personnel and missing DGAs. Output conforms to the section2-personnel-eligibility-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping section2-personnel-eligibility workflow's two parallel Extraction tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt.

data.name: extract-section-2-personnel
data.prompt:
You are extracting the personnel-extraction block from VERAS
Sections 2.1 (PI + Co-PIs) and 2.2A (Senior / Key Personnel).
Mirrors TASK-01 of the source ProcessMapping
section2-personnel-eligibility workflow.

Be 100% accurate. Quote names and roles verbatim. Do not invent
personnel.

For each searchset item return the document's stated values:

- section_21_personnel: JSON array of {name, role, institution}
  objects from VERAS Section 2.1. role is one of "PI", "Co-PI".
  institution is null when not stated. MUST contain at least
  one entry (every proposal has a PI).

- section_22_personnel: JSON array of {name, role, institution}
  objects from VERAS Section 2.2A. role is always
  "Senior/Key Personnel". institution is null when not stated.
  Empty array when Section 2.2A is not populated.

- total_personnel_count: JSON integer (sum of Section 2.1 +
  Section 2.2A entries).

- pi_copis_requiring_eligibility: JSON array of strings —
  the names from section_21_personnel (PI / Co-PI only). These
  are the people who need APM 45.22 eligibility verification.

- personnel_requiring_org_code_only: JSON array of strings —
  the names from section_22_personnel (Senior / Key only).
  These people need org-code collection but NOT eligibility
  checks. Empty array when Section 2.2A is empty.

data.name: extract-eligibility-and-dga-verification
data.prompt:
You are performing the eligibility and DGA verification for the
personnel identified in VERAS Section 2. Mirrors TASK-02 of the
source ProcessMapping section2-personnel-eligibility workflow.

Sources to read (all uploaded as workflow documents, except APM
45.22 which is consumed from the knowledge base / search
corpus):
- Banner NBAJOBS extract for every person on the proposal.
- Institutional Department List mapping org codes to
  departments and DGAs.
- APM Section 45.22 (knowledge base) — authoritative list of
  job titles eligible for PI / Co-PI status at the University
  of Idaho.

Be 100% accurate. Do NOT assume employment, eligibility, or DGA
mapping. When a job title is ambiguous (clinical faculty,
lecturer, adjunct, dual appointment), emit
eligibility_status: "Review Required" with evidence describing
the ambiguity — never "Eligible" or "Not Eligible".

When a workflow document is missing, emit non-compliant
defaults and capture the gap in notes_about_missing_sources.

For each searchset item return the document's stated values:

- personnel_verification: JSON array of per-person
  {name, found_in_banner, current_employee, job_title,
   timesheet_org_code, notes} objects. One entry per person
  from the combined Section 2.1 + Section 2.2A list. notes
  captures duplicate-name disambiguation, terminated-employee
  flags, external-collaborator flags. When Banner is not
  provided, set found_in_banner: false for every person.

- eligibility_check: JSON array of per-PI / Co-PI
  {name, role, job_title, eligibility_status, evidence}
  objects. One entry per PI / Co-PI ONLY (do NOT emit entries
  for Senior / Key Personnel). eligibility_status is one of
  "Eligible", "Not Eligible", "Review Required". evidence is a
  short APM 45.22 citation or rationale.

- org_code_compilation: JSON array of
  {org_code, personnel_names, count} objects, one entry per
  unique timesheet org code across all personnel.

- dga_mapping: JSON array of
  {org_code, department_name, dga_names} objects, one entry
  per unique org code. dga_names is an array (multiple DGAs
  per org code are supported). When an org code is NOT in the
  Department List, department_name: null and dga_names: [].

- dga_cross_reference: JSON array of
  {dga_name, org_codes, listed_in_section_2, action_needed}
  objects, one entry per unique DGA pulled from dga_mapping.
  org_codes is the array of codes this DGA covers.
  listed_in_section_2 is true when the DGA name appears in
  section_21_personnel or section_22_personnel.
  action_needed is one of "No action needed" or
  "FLAG — Must be added to Section 2".

- notes_about_missing_sources: short string describing any
  workflow document that was not provided, or null when all
  sources are present.

data.name: section2-personnel-eligibility-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Section 2 Personnel
Eligibility Verification workflow. You receive two extraction
outputs from the previous step (personnel extraction +
eligibility / DGA verification) and must emit a SINGLE JSON
object that validates against the
section2-personnel-eligibility-udm@0.1.0 schema (schema.json
in the component directory).

## Output contract

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no closing commentary,
no markdown fences. If your runtime requires fenced output, wrap
in a single ```json ... ``` block and emit nothing outside it.

Top-level keys (in this order): `personnel_extraction`,
`personnel_verification`, `eligibility_check`,
`org_code_compilation`, `dga_mapping`, `dga_cross_reference`,
`verification_summary`.

## Field-by-field assembly

### personnel_extraction

Pass through section_21_personnel, section_22_personnel,
total_personnel_count, pi_copis_requiring_eligibility,
personnel_requiring_org_code_only as the extractor returned
them. section_21_personnel must be non-empty.

### personnel_verification

Pass through the array. One entry per person from
section_21_personnel + section_22_personnel combined. When
Banner is not provided, every entry has found_in_banner: false
and all dependent fields null.

### eligibility_check

Pass through the array. One entry per PI / Co-PI ONLY. Senior /
Key Personnel must NOT appear here. When a PI / Co-PI has no
Banner record (found_in_banner: false), emit
eligibility_status: "Review Required" with evidence "Banner
record not found — cannot evaluate job title."

### org_code_compilation

Pass through. One entry per unique timesheet org code. count is
a JSON integer equal to personnel_names.length.

### dga_mapping

Pass through. One entry per unique org code. When an org code
has no Department List entry, department_name: null and
dga_names: [].

### dga_cross_reference

Pass through. One entry per unique DGA pulled from
dga_mapping.dga_names. listed_in_section_2 is true when the DGA
name is present in section_21_personnel or
section_22_personnel. action_needed:
- "No action needed" when listed_in_section_2 is true
- "FLAG — Must be added to Section 2" when listed_in_section_2
  is false

### verification_summary (derive)

{
  "total_personnel_verified":
    personnel_extraction.total_personnel_count,
  "pi_copis_eligible_count": count of eligibility_check entries
    with eligibility_status "Eligible",
  "pi_copis_not_eligible": array of names from eligibility_check
    with eligibility_status "Not Eligible",
  "pi_copis_review_required": array of names from
    eligibility_check with eligibility_status "Review Required",
  "unique_org_codes_count": org_code_compilation.length,
  "dgas_required_count": dga_cross_reference.length,
  "dgas_in_section_2_count": count of dga_cross_reference
    entries with listed_in_section_2 true,
  "missing_dgas": array of dga_name from dga_cross_reference
    entries with action_needed
    "FLAG — Must be added to Section 2",
  "unmapped_org_codes": array of org_code from dga_mapping
    entries with department_name null,
  "notes": null OR a single string capturing any missing-source
    warnings + ambiguous-match disambiguation notes.
}

## Cross-field rules (from source workflow)

1. Every PI / Co-PI in eligibility_check has eligibility_status
   populated — never null. If no Banner record exists, use
   "Review Required".
2. Every unique org code from personnel_verification appears in
   dga_mapping (with null department_name + empty dga_names
   when not in the Department List).
3. Every DGA from dga_mapping.dga_names is cross-referenced in
   dga_cross_reference.

## Quality bar

- Output validates against schema.json (draft 2020-12).
- Counts are JSON integers >= 0.
- Booleans (found_in_banner, current_employee,
  listed_in_section_2) are JSON booleans.
- No fabricated eligibility / employment / DGA mapping. When a
  source is missing, the contract emits non-compliant defaults
  and captures the gap in verification_summary.notes.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify all personnel from Sections 2.1 and 2.2A are extracted.
Verify every PI and Co-PI has an APM 45.22 eligibility determination.
Verify every person has a timesheet org code recorded (or is flagged when no Banner record exists).
Verify every unique org code maps to a DGA (or is flagged in unmapped_org_codes).
